name: MWR16718
warning_message:
has two rollers (RHS No. 8 & LHS No. 2) are leaking—an indication of premature failure.

Feedback received from the OEM indicates that the most common cause of this type of failure is incorrect travel procedure, specifically:

    Failure to adhere to the correct “Travel Position” (Operator’s Manual – Page 4-5).

    Not following the “Long Travel Procedure” (Operator’s Manual – Page 4-9), which is designed to allow rollers, idlers, and final drives to cool during prolonged travel.

Data shows that the machine was operated in continuous travel for 41.7 minutes on 04/06/2025 and 35.4 minutes on 06/06/2025 without any cooling breaks. This causes excessive load on specific rollers, leading to overheating, lip seal damage, and oil leaks.
